description.value: Whenever a creature you can see that threatens you makes an attack against one of your allies, as an immediate action , you can compel that creature to attack you instead. When you compel a creature to attack you, you must first overcome that creature’s spell resistance , and the creature can attempt a Will saving throw to ignore the compulsion.
